Hi Sabrina / Marissa 

Thanks for the note  looping in answers and attachments. Short answers up front:

1) Marketplace: Redwood is listed on AWS Marketplace for certain plans (metered billing is available for our hosted API); however, Dedicated/Private deployments typically require a contract and are not auto-metered via Marketplace. If you'd like, we can evaluate listing the pilot configuration  typically takes 23 weeks for onboarding + legal review.

2) PO / Invoice cadence: We support PO-based billing and issue invoices on a monthly cadence by default; standard payment terms are Net30. We can accommodate Net45/Net60 on a case-by-case enterprise agreement.

3) Attachments included: a clean SOW (Redwood_SOW_template_v1.pdf) and a filled procurement Q&A template (procurement_questionnaire_acme.xlsx) with short answers.

Next recommended path:
- If Acme wants to proceed with a pilot under P-card (under ~$10k), we can fast-track via card. If the pilot is expected to exceed that threshold or you prefer procurement-managed billing, we'll proceed with PO + SOW + standard redline window.
- For PO-based deals, please share the PO terms and the budget owner + signatory contact. Once we have a PO we can generate an invoice and route to finance.

Ethan (cc'd on earlier thread)  if you could confirm budget availability and the finance sponsor who will approve the PO, that will help speed things.

Happy to jump on a quick procurement sync with your team this week if helpful.
